title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of all privileged accounts configured on endpoint computing systems.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of all privileged accounts configured on server computing systems.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of all privileged accounts configured on network devices.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of all privileged accounts configured on enterprise business applications.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure all privileged accounts on endpoint computing systems are authorized and dedicated privileged accounts are required.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure all privileged accounts on server computing systems are authorized and require dedicated privileged accounts.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure all privileged accounts on network devices are authorized and require dedicated privileged accounts.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure all privileged accounts on enterprise business applications are authorized and require dedicated privileged accounts.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure all default privileged accounts are not using their default system credentials to authenticate to the system.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization does not allow shared privileged accounts for workforce members except in documented cases for emergency access or via a Privileged Account Management (PAM) system.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Privileged Account Management (PAM) or Password Manager (PM) system for documenting service accounts, shared accounts, or shared secrets between workforce members.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Privileged Account Management (PAM) system to automatically rotate the credentials, using unique credentials, for each endpoint or server computing system.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Privileged Account Management (PAM) system to automatically rotate the credentials, using unique credentials, for each network device.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all privileged accounts.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) log and alert when changes are made to privileged group memberships.

title: Privileged Account Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) log and alert account logon events, both successful and failed, for all privileged accounts.
